title: Learning Bitcoin: a Free Path for Beginners
plain:
Before moving meaningful money — yours or an inheritance — learn the basics from a structured, free source. BTC Sessions (Ben Perrin) publishes a free 'Zero to Hero' track on YouTube (youtube.com/@BTCSessions) that stacks the most relevant skills for your bitcoin journey, organized into beginner, intermediate, and master tiers on one page.

The order is the point. Start with mobile wallets, then hardware wallets, then buying bitcoin; continue with privacy, mining, and running a node; and only then take on the master material — a Lightning node, accepting bitcoin payments, and inheritance. Multisig has its own playlist in the 'Dive Deeper' section. Following the sequence means your early mistakes happen with small amounts and simple setups, not with family savings.

This app is a companion for custody and inheritance planning — it complements self-education and never replaces it. Work through the free curriculum first, then use this guidance when designing your own plan.
technical:
Curriculum reference: BTC Sessions' free Zero to Hero outline (Ben Perrin, youtube.com/@BTCSessions) organizes tutorials into three tiers — Beginner: Mobile Wallets, Hardware Wallets, Buying Bitcoin; Intermediate: Privacy, Mining, Nodes; Master: Lightning Node, Accept Bitcoin Payments, Inheritance — plus Dive Deeper playlists covering Buy & Sell, Mobile Wallets, Hardware Wallets, Nodes, Mining, Privacy, and Multi-sig. The progression runs from wallets to buying to operational topics (privacy, mining, nodes) to advanced use (Lightning, accepting payments), with Inheritance positioned as a Master-tier topic and Multi-sig available as a deeper playlist bridging single-key and quorum custody.

For a reader planning an inheritance, the outline's sequencing is the takeaway: wallet basics and buying come first, privacy and node operation next, and inheritance material assumes all of them. This entry intentionally names no other vendors; the standing guidance is to complete free, structured education before executing an inheritance plan.

warnings: Do not skip the Beginner tier; the Master-tier inheritance material assumes you already handle wallets, buying, privacy, mining, and nodes.
Do not jump straight to multi-sig or inheritance playlists before single-key wallet basics are second nature.
Do not move meaningful money — yours or a family inheritance — while you are still learning basic wallet operations.
Do not treat this app as a substitute for the free curriculum; it complements self-education and never replaces it.
